title.narrative: Programa de Agua, Saneamiento Bsico y Electrificacin para el Pacfico Colombia
Water, Basic Sanitation, and Electrification Program for the Colombian Pacific R

description.narrative: El objetivo general del programa es contribuir a disminuir las brechas de acceso a los servicios de Agua Potable y Saneamiento Bsico (AS), y electrificacin en el Litoral del Pacfico Colombiano (LPC). Los objetivos especficos son contribuir a: (i) incrementar el acceso y mejorar los servicios de AS en Quibd y Buenaventura (QyB); y (ii) promover el acceso a un servicio de energa elctrica confiable, eficiente y sostenible a la poblacin del LPC, incluyendo la promocin de soluciones energticas sostenibles que reduzcan la dependencia de los combustibles fsiles.

The overall objective of the program is to help narrow gaps in access to potable water, basic sanitation, and electricity services in the Colombian Pacific region. Its specific objectives are to help: (i) increase access to and upgrade water and basic sanitation services in Quibd and Buenaventura; and (ii) promote access to reliable, efficient, and sustainable electricity service for the population of the Colombian Pacific region, including the promotion of sustainable energy solutions that reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
